description: NaMgNdWO₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-3.03 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-33°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.15 Å. Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.69 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-33°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.09 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, one Nd, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg, two equivalent Nd, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, two equivalent Nd, and one W atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, two equivalent Nd, and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, one Nd, and one W atom.
